preliminary_turnout.derivation: Sum of the 50 state estimates; equals the native national row minus the native DC row. Not a geographic allocation.

source_methodology.author: Michael McDonald
source_methodology.source_population_definition: The native turnout page defines the numerator as total ballots counted, not votes for governor or U.S. Senator. Preliminary numerators are estimated primarily from Associated Press day-after turnout estimates until reporting and certification progress.
source_methodology.source_uncertainty: The publisher identifies substantial uncertainty where turnout reporting is incomplete, especially California and Washington. No state-specific uncertainty intervals are supplied by these selected files.
source_methodology.documentation_limit: The older linked v0.1 documentation still says TBD for TOTAL_BALLOTS_COUNTED and SOURCE. The definition above comes from the current native turnout page, not an invented codebook definition.
source_methodology.clock_limit: The dataset page, native turnout page and CSV HTTP Last-Modified are separate provenance observations. No native page timezone is supplied; retrieval/HTTP clocks are not substituted for it.

search_snapshot_resolution.resolution: Inspecting the native HTML and declared CSV loader resolves the apparent disagreement. The current page points to the exact frozen CSV. The search-index number is not a second current observation and is excluded.

source_methodology.republication: Complete native CSV and documentation are included under their documented CC-BY4.0 license with attribution. This selected factual review is not a mirror of the full webpage or its JavaScript.

assumptions_and_limits: UF estimates total ballots; every native source row says Initial Estimate. These are not official observed or certified counts.
The reference additionally assumes each contest's recalled-choice composition represents all state ballot-casters; exact response selection remains unresolved.
Some current choices are retained pre-election choices after failed recontact; this is not universal completed-vote or administrative choice validation.
Returning=N26*q; reported opposite-party choices=N26*q*p; apparent absence=T24-N26*q. FEC T24 is official; N26 and the transitions are conditional estimates.
Apparent absence includes migration, mortality, recall and population-estimation error, not only staying home. Negative residuals are retained.
Current N composition means reported no 2024 presidential vote, not no ballot in any 2024 contest, first-time voting, eligibility entry or identified returning voters.
Current N/O counts equal N26 times their published composition. D/R choice flows use only published conditional cells; suppressed choices remain null.
Composition is not renormalized; its signed difference from100 is a rounding diagnostic, not identified missing people.
Count scales0.95/1/1.05 and balanced recall transfers+-2pp are symmetric stress assumptions, not estimated missing ballots or confidence intervals.
Half-point rounding envelopes are marginal, not confidence intervals. These scenarios do not exhaust sampling, recall or population uncertainty.

SSRS did not sample DC. National House uses the sum of50state turnout estimates and the official50state prior coalitions, excluding DC from both years. The entire native national and DC rows are retained; this is scope matching, not geographic allocation.
Never add offices, national and state results, or marginal endpoints.
No state-to-demographic, county or precinct allocation; no causal persuasion or share-of-overall-swing estimate. No reweighting2026to2024Trump/Harris shares.
